data.name: Pyarelal
data.gender_notes: Pyarelal is used as a masculine name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from 'Pyare' meaning loved and 'Lal' meaning God. It signifies being loved by the divine. The name Pyarelal carries the meaning “Loved by God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Pyarelal usually hope their child will grow to embody loved by god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: This name is believed to evoke the blessings of the deity Pyare, who is regarded as the embodiment of love and compassion.
data.etymology: Pyarelal belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Loved by God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pyarelal total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Pyarelal holds a significant place in Indian culture and particularly in the Hindu community. It is a name rooted in emotional depth and devotion. Often, in movies or literature, the name Pyarelal evokes a sense of selflessness, devotion, and pure love towards the divine. This name is also associated with the profound bhakti (devotion) movement in Hinduism.
data.spiritual_significance: At its core, the name Pyarelal holds a deep spiritual significance, representing the concept that true love and devotion lie in being in communion with the divine. Pyarelal is a reminder of the eternal connection between the individual soul and the divine. It encourages us to seek the love and guidance of the divine, and to strive towards purifying our hearts and minds to be worthy of that divine love. In essence, Pyarelal signifies a deep spiritual journey towards self-realization and union with the divine.
